question:
**Direction: Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A container for housing honeybees
solution: The correct answer is **"Hive."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hive"** is a noun that means a structure for housing honeybees. (मधुमक्खियों के आवास के लिए एक संरचना) • **Example**: *Bees naturally attack anything entering their **hives**__.* • It is a commonly used term in beekeeping and agriculture. • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Colonies**: A group of honeybees living together. (मधुमक्खियों का एक समूह जो एक साथ रहता है) • **Pack**: A group of animals, especially wolves, living and hunting together. (जानवरों का एक समूह, विशेषकर भेड़िये, जो एक साथ रहते हैं और शिकार करते हैं) • **Shoal**: A large group of fish swimming together. (मछलियों का एक बड़ा समूह एक साथ तैर रहा है) 3d:T6c0, The correct answer is **"There are many good tunes."**
